_comment: TA reference: a fully correct student submission, used to self-test the checker. Uses the second valid handshake set and a non-default ping pair on purpose, to prove the checker accepts alternatives.
explanation: The WPA2 passphrase only unlocks the 802.11 link-layer encryption (CCMP). The decrypted frames reveal an IPsec ESP tunnel inside, which is encrypted with separate keys negotiated between the endpoints; recovering the Wi-Fi password gives no access to those ESP session keys, so the inner payload stays confidential. Wi-Fi encryption protects the wireless hop; the ESP layer is end-to-end encryption carried within it.
